results.title: Lindsey Vonn ‘nervous and anxious’ for ninth surgery after horrific Olympic crash
results.description: Legendary Olympic women’s skier Lindsey Vonn is heading for another surgery. Vonn revealed in a pre-recorded Instagram video that she is going under the knife for a ninth time on Tuesday, once again having a procedure on her leg. The 2010 gold medalist shared her thoughts as she prepared for the operation and the recovery...
